title: Agent Hooks — agent_startup response
description: Responses for hooks that forbid transforms.

extensions.description:
Namespaced extensions (§4.6): any value under a key that follows the
namespace rule.

NonTransformVerdict.description: Verdict choices for hooks that do not support transforms.

AllowVerdict.description: allow: proceed. Absorbs warn through warnings[] (§5.1).

reason.description:
Interceptor-supplied machine identifier. The host_error: prefix is reserved
for host-synthesized failures (§11).

warnings.description:
Recorded concerns that do not affect control flow (§5.1). Permitted on any
decision; unioned across an emission's verdicts (§7.3). Reasons starting with
host_warning: are reserved for the host (§11.1).

evidence.description: Offline-verifiable evidence attached to a verdict (§14).

result_labels.description:
Interceptor-supplied labels the host MUST persist with the produced data and
resurface on later interception points (§5.4).

Warning.description: A recorded concern that does not affect control flow (§5.1).

reason.description:
Interceptor-supplied warning identifier. The host_error: prefix is reserved
for host-synthesized failures (§11) and host_warning: for host-synthesized
warnings (§11.1); an interceptor warning with either prefix fails §5
validation.

Evidence.description: Offline-verifiable evidence attached to a verdict (§14).

artefact.description: Content address (sha256:<hex>) or URI of an offline-verifiable proof.

verification_pointers.description: Named URIs an auditor MAY consult. Hosts MUST NOT dereference automatically (§14).

VerificationPointers.description: Named URIs an auditor MAY consult. Hosts MUST NOT dereference automatically (§14).

DenyVerdict.description: deny: stop the action. Absorbs escalate through the approval block (§5.1).

approval.description:
Present only on deny: marks the deny as liftable by the approval seam (§9).
MAY be empty; reserved for approver-facing parameters.
